"Supplerende analyser 7: Alvorlig blødning" (Supplementary Analysis 7: Severe Bleeding) is a dedicated analytical section within the [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] report [^src1]. This report serves as a central component of the regional quality development program for atrial fibrillation (AFDK), which is administered by the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) [^src1]. The primary significance of this specific analysis is its focus on the incidence of severe bleeding among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients, with data stratified by the type of anticoagulation treatment they receive—namely DOACs, Marevan, combination therapy, or no treatment [^src1].

The data for this analysis is drawn from a specific reporting period that runs from July 1, 2024, to June 30, 2025 [^src1]. The findings are presented at the national, regional, and health cluster levels, accompanied by confidence intervals [^src1]. The underlying dataset relies on linkages with the Danish Civil Registration System (CPR register) and is strictly restricted to patients who possess a Danish CPR number and official residence [^src1]. 

The authors of the report note a critical methodological limitation regarding this analysis: the use of unadjusted proportions carries a risk of case-mix effects [^src1]. As a result, making direct comparisons between different healthcare units is problematic unless the data is adjusted for underlying demographic and clinical factors [^src1]. Alongside the bleeding analysis, this section of the report also concurrently covers mortality data (Indicator 9) [^src1].
